entries.text: Worked on the Little Dart Mk 20 (version 12, 99% built): welding high-entropy silicate ceramic aerogel panels to the upper hull of the Little Dart using Fen (used Dibs, a tiny gyroscope)
welding custom high-entropy ceramic tiles onto the upper hull of the Little Dart
entries.why: every panel we weld gets us one step closer to actual space flight.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Upper hull ceramic panels!"

entries.why: every single rivet brings us one step closer to actual flight.
